subject: CLANG
body:
So you went after a royal without Big Bertha!

They wear some kind of ward. Most of what you hit them with just bounces off. The ants have been whispering. "Big Bertha brings down the royals."

Twenty-seven pieces of the worst things alive in one sword. It'll be worth it. Go build her, then go back.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
